# Grit.hu

> A sensemaking and wellbeing platform for people affected by high-conflict relational dynamics, offering a curated knowledge library, structured self-reflection tools, and private pattern observation — presented with warm, human language while mapping inputs to clinical codes (SNOMED CT / BNO-10) in the background.

## Pages

- [/](/): Landing page with platform overview, feature highlights, and waitlist access.
- [/surveys](/surveys): Public self-check questionnaires (published) available without an account.
